Big Challenge! Gun Fighter.name: Big Challenge! Gun Fighter
Big Challenge! Gun Fighter.summary: A sheriff must take down the outlaws of the wild west, and uncover the greater mysterious that has terrorized the town for decades.

Date de Blackjack.name: Date de Blackjack
Date de Blackjack.summary: Date de Blackjack is a Miscellaneous game, developed and published by Hacker International, which was released in Asia in 1988. It is an adult blackjack game by Hacker International in which you will play a girl in poker. Upon winning enough, you will have interactions with her in which she slowly undresses.

Koneko Monogatari - The Adventures of Ch.name: Koneko Monogatari: The Adventures of Chatran
Koneko Monogatari - The Adventures of Ch.summary: The story of two animals and their adventures. Chatran, the cat, and Pocky, the dog, are two animals who grew up together on the same farm. One day, the two are separated and begin a journey to find each other. The adventurous, and often perilous quest finds the two animals traveling across mountains, plains, and snow-covered lands searching for one another.
